quests.title: A Note on the Door
quests.summary: The Counting House has chalked the debtors' doors in the Sump. Work off one note, or bring goods or coin, before the Reckoning.

objectives.label: Free one debtor: lend a paw at their work or with a trouble, or bring two loaves, salt, herbs or lamp oil, or ten coins.

rewards.detail: freed a chalked door in the Sump

quests.title: A Ledger That Does Not Add Up
quests.summary: Rosalind Greatly has found a ledger in the Counting House that doesn't add up. She can't carry it out herself.

offer.say: #greet#. I've read every ledger in the Counting House, and one of them doesn't add up. I can't carry it out myself. Could you?
offer.ask: You look like you have found a mistake.
offer.accept: I'll carry it out for you.
offer.handIn: I've what the ledger was missing.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Counted twice, then: once to the debtor and once to the Crown. Now tell me where it should go.
offer.during: The steward has the day book. The customs tallyman has the Crown's tally. The pawnbroker has the factors' notes. The Bank knows the rest.
offer.duringAsk: Where do I find the other sums?

objectives.label: Get the Counting House day book from the steward of Greatly House: free his note (then ask him for it), or promise him.
Climb to the collector's room of the Customs House.
Read the Crown's customs tally with Jasper Bilgeford.
Win the pawnbroker of the Pawn and Ledger over with a gift, for the factors' notes.
Have Eleanor Saltcot at the Greatly Bank confirm the sums.

rewards.detail: read the ledger that does not add up

rewards.text: The Sump debts are charged twice, once to the debtor and once to the Crown. In the margin: "Deepvein note: pledged to three." Ask Rosalind where it should go.

quests.title: The Captain's Note
quests.summary: Captain Corra Slagmore of the Watch owes the Counting House, and won't talk of it in her own Watch House. Free her note, or find who sold it to Greatly.

objectives.label: Ask the Captain of the Watch about her note, at the Keep.
Free the Captain's note (it counts three times).
Or ask the keeper of the cells who sold her note.
Settle the Captain's note, one way or the other.

rewards.detail: found out who sold the Captain's note

rewards.text: #greet#. Not in my own Watch House, I said, and I meant it. But I know whose doing it was. #thanks#.

quests.title: The Ear in the Residence
quests.summary: A kitchen servant of the Residence keeps far more coin than her wage. Somebody pays her to listen.

objectives.label: Ask Mab Coalridge where a kitchen servant gets two hundred pennies.
Ask the moneychanger at the Greatly Bank about the ink on her coin.
Follow Mab after dark, close enough to see which door she knocks at.
Tell the lamp-keeper, or tell the Queen, or take her coin.

rewards.detail: found the ear in the Residence

quests.title: The Seam Note
quests.summary: House Greatly holds the Frosthollow mine's note, and the mine is short of its quota. The mine captain has his own idea.

objectives.label: Ask the mine captain at the Frosthollow mine about the note.
Choose: fill the quota honestly, or see to the Counting House rider's letters.
Bring the mine captain ten iron ore.
Or hunt three beasts around Frosthollow for the miners' larder.
The mine's quota.

quests.title: The Counting House's Errand
quests.summary: Rune Gullwell of the Counting House has an errand for a friend of the House: carry its pledge to a debtor not yet freed, and have it signed.

objectives.label: Give the Counting House pledge to a debtor not yet freed.

rewards.text: The pledge is signed. The Counting House remembers its friends, and its rates.

Advance anyway on day 3: the ledger kept, the coin taken, the Purse errand; pushed
